videos.title: Four Froggies: Catch Jimmy All the Way to the Moon
videos.description: When Jimmy zooms off on his jetpack with a secret golden orb, James, Bubbles and Rexy blast off in the Starship to catch him, past Mars, King Germy's crystal caves and Jupiter's icy moon, all the way to a bouncy moon buggy chase on the Moon. A 14-minute animated adventure for kids about friendship, space and real moon physics.

videos.title: Four Froggies: Catch Jimmy All the Way to the Moon (Version 2)
videos.description: Version 2: a shorter, tighter retelling. Jimmy's new jetpack sends him zooming off across the solar system, and James, Bubbles and Rexy chase him from Mars to Callisto to the Moon, with Purple Bear guiding them by phone, until all four froggies fly home together.
